# Jackie Risk

> Senior Product Designer with 10 years of experience leading end-to-end UX across SaaS, enterprise, and federal platforms. Currently at Workleap, focused on information architecture, navigation, design systems, and AI-augmented prototyping.

## Pages

- [About](about.html): Background, experience at Workleap and EAGLE6, and working style.
- [Work](work.html): Selected case studies.
- [Officevibe Top Manager Awards](case-studies/officevibe-awards.html): A product-led growth experiment: a shareable recognition feature that drove a 69% engagement rate and roughly 150,000 organic LinkedIn impressions.
- [Migrating Pingboard into Workleap](case-studies/pingboard-migration.html): Customer-facing migration UX for moving existing Pingboard customers onto the unified Workleap platform, including redirects, integration re-authentication, relocated-feature guidance, and a phased communication plan. The migration is complete.
- [EAGLE6 Status Dashboard](case-studies/eagle6-status-dashboard.html): Dashboards designed as Principal Product Designer for U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs stakeholders and analysts, to help them understand the impact of infrastructure changes during the migration from the legacy MUMPS system to the Cerner electronic health record platform. Imagery is mockup only because of PHI risk.
- [Contact](contact.html): Get in touch via the contact form.

## Notes

Jackie Risk is a UX/product designer, not a language model or software product. This file exists to help AI tools accurately summarize her background and work.
